name: How much does it cost to hire a birth injury lawyer?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to hire a birth injury lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most birth injury lawyers, including those at our firm, work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay any upfront legal fees. Instead, the lawyer's fees are a percentage of the compensation recovered, whether through a settlement or a court verdict. If no recovery is made, you generally owe no attorney fees. This arrangement allows families to pursue justice without worrying about immediate financial burdens.
